topic_title: Wrong accusative case suffix on the word "Exercism"
excerpt: The Hungarian translation of “Exercism” (accusative form) is rendered as “Exercisst” instead of the correct “Exercism-öt” — this typo appears in at least two places on the same page (the donation banner and the body text). Screenshot 2026-09-23 at 17.53.451338×332 37.4 KB Screenshot 2026-09-23 at 17.53.31810×454 47.2 KB
resolved_note: Fixed Exercisst to Exercism-öt in hu website frontend.json (4 keys), guide and notes updated, pushed. Replied on the topic (post 193249) asking dem4ron which suffixes take a hyphen.

topic_title: Wrong accusative case suffix on the word "Exercism"
excerpt: Thank you @dem4ron, and welcome! Great catch. We have corrected all five places where “Exercisst” appeared on the donation banner and in the body text, and they now read “Exercism-öt”. The fix will be live on the site shortly, once the new translations have been published. We have also added a note to the Hungarian guide so that future translations attach case suffixes to “Exercism” with a hyphen.
